content: US Level 3 (slot-controlled, IATA fully coordinated) airports: JFK, LGA, DCA. High Density Rule (14 CFR 93) originally covered 5 airports (JFK, LGA, DCA, ORD, EWR) from 1969; JFK's HDR application ended 2007, replaced by FAA Order Limiting Operations (extended through Oct 2026), currently 81 scheduled ops/hour. DCA slot cap: 48 scheduled ops/hour, 6am-11:59pm, per 14 CFR part 93 subparts K and S.
